tagline: Up the Mystic River's east bank into Old Mystic.
intro: North of Jerry Browne Road, Route 27 keeps close to the east bank of the Mystic River, with the water in view, and turns into Main Street through the village of Old Mystic before it ends at Route 184. The scenic part is short.
The river is a mostly tidal estuary that held three large shipbuilding firms in the 19th century. Its name comes from the Pequot missi-tuk, a large river driven into waves by tide or wind.

moments.title: Mystic River
moments.text: The road runs close alongside the river from Jerry Browne Road up toward the village, with the water in view.

moments.title: Mystic Bank
moments.text: On Main Street stands a small brick Greek Revival bank, built in 1856 for a bank founded to serve the shipbuilders and later the town's meeting hall and polling place.
